mapper.select: select d.branch_uuid as "branchUuid", d.project_uuid as "projectUuid", d.branch_key as "branchKey", d.branch_type as "branchType", d.target_branch_key as "targetBranchKey" from cs_retain_details d where d.branch_uuid = #{branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into cs_retain_details ( branch_uuid, project_uuid, branch_key, branch_type, target_branch_key ) values ( #{dto.branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.branchKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.branchType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.targetBranchKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select d.branch_uuid as "branchUuid", d.branch_key as "branchKey", d.branch_type as "branchType", d.target_branch_key as "targetBranchKey", case when pb.uuid is null then ${_false} else ${_true} end as "active", count(t.uuid) as "issueCount" from cs_retain_details d left join project_branches pb on pb.uuid = d.branch_uuid left join cs_issue_track_for_retain t on t.branch_uuid = d.branch_uuid where d.project_uuid = #{projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by d.branch_uuid, d.branch_key, d.branch_type, d.target_branch_key, pb.uuid order by d.branch_type, d.branch_key, d.branch_uuid
mapper.sql: t.uuid as "uuid", t.branch_uuid as "branchUuid", t.issue_kee as "issueKey", t.retained_status as "retainedStatus", t.rule_uuid as "ruleUuid", t.component_key as "componentKey", t.message as "message", t.severity as "severity", t.issue_type as "issueType", t.tags as "tags", t.assignee_uuid as "assigneeUuid", t.status_marked_by_uuid as "statusMarkedByUuid", t.issue_creation_date as "issueCreationDate", t.fixed_at as "fixedAt"
mapper.insert: insert into cs_issue_track_for_retain ( uuid, branch_uuid, issue_kee, retained_status, rule_uuid, component_key, message, severity, issue_type, tags, assignee_uuid, status_marked_by_uuid, issue_creation_date, fixed_at ) values ( #{dto.uuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.issueKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.retainedStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.ruleUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.componentKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.message, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.severity, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.issueType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{dto.tags, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.assigneeUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.statusMarkedByUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.issueCreationDate, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{dto.fixedAt, jdbcType=BIGINT} )
mapper.select: select count(1) from cs_issue_track_for_retain t inner join cs_retain_details d on d.branch_uuid = t.branch_uuid where d.project_uuid = #{projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into cs_retain_issue_comments ( uuid, issue_kee, change_data, user_uuid, issue_change_creation_date ) select ic.uuid, ic.issue_key, ic.change_data, ic.user_login, ic.issue_change_creation_date from issue_changes ic where ic.project_uuid = #{branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ic.change_type = 'comment' and exists (select 1 from cs_issue_track_for_retain t where t.issue_kee = ic.issue_key) and not exists (select 1 from cs_retain_issue_comments c where c.uuid = ic.uuid)
mapper.delete: delete from cs_retain_issue_comments where issue_kee in ( select t.issue_kee from cs_issue_track_for_retain t inner join cs_retain_details d on d.branch_uuid = t.branch_uuid where d.project_uuid = #{projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
delete from cs_retain_details where project_uuid = #{projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
